Twelve meals feed 18 people, so each meal feeds 18/12 = 3/2 people. To feed 12 people, they need 12 ÷ (3/2) = 8 meals.

Solution A reaches 8, which is correct. Its reasoning is loosely worded, but the result is right.

Solution B sets up x/12 = 1/(3/2) = 2/3, which gives x = 8. Cross-multiplying to get 2x = 12 is an algebra error, so its answer of 6 is wrong.

WINNER: A
